# Ayush Patne
AI Engineer | MSc Advanced Computer Science (AI), University of Leeds

## Professional Profile
Ayush builds and evaluates AI systems, from multi-agent LLM pipelines to RL fine-tuning studies and embedding retrieval services. He was an AI Engineer at Hopps, a research assistant on LLM systems at the University of Leeds, and is completing an MSc in Advanced Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) at the University of Leeds.

## Technical Expertise
- **LLM & GenAI:** vLLM, LangGraph, multi-agent pipelines, quantization and speculative decoding, LLM-as-judge evaluation and calibration, RAG, embedding models, ONNX/FastEmbed
- **Research:** LoRA SFT, GRPO, reward and verifier design, mechanistic interpretability (logit lens, probing, PCA, attention analysis), representation learning
- **Machine Learning:** PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, SciPy
- **Backend & Deployment:** FastAPI, Docker, GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions), PostgreSQL/Supabase, SQLite, Firebase

## Key Projects
- **TRACE:** A controlled study of reward hacking in RL fine-tuning. SmolLM2-360M-Instruct trained with LoRA SFT then GRPO against a weak and a strong reward verifier; the strong verifier reached 93% exact match through a shortcut, localised to layers 23 to 29 with logit lens and probes. Write-up: https://ayushxpatne.github.io/projects/trace/
- **Vocabscapes:** A five-agent LangGraph pipeline (writer, judge, improver, finalizer, explanation) generating word puzzles, with bounded retries and cached variants per level. Live: https://vocabscapes.web.app . Write-up: https://ayushxpatne.github.io/projects/vocabscapes/
- **LLM eval harness:** LLM-as-judge evaluation across four writer and critic model pairs, calibrated against blind human ratings. Write-up: https://ayushxpatne.github.io/projects/puzzle-eval-harness/
- **maybehere:** Group restaurant discovery app with 97,000+ place profiles across ~200 UK towns, semantic retrieval on BGE-small with ONNX/FastEmbed on Cloud Run. Live: https://maybehere.app
- **Rosetta & OnePiece:** A model-agnostic, fixed-size (32-D) LLM representation method and a ~1,000-parameter plug-and-play memory retriever built on it. Pre-prints in progress.
- **Federated learning:** Privacy-preserving fraud detection on Ethereum transactions across three clients, without sharing data. Write-up: https://ayushxpatne.github.io/projects/fl-fraud-detection/
- **Social media recommendation engine:** A recommender built from scratch with Gemini embeddings, FAISS IndexIVF retrieval and an exploitation-exploration mix. Write-up: https://ayushxpatne.github.io/projects/social-media-recsys/
- **UNDP climate survey analysis:** Predicting and segmenting public support for climate action across 73,000+ respondents in 73 countries. Write-up: https://ayushxpatne.github.io/projects/undp-climate-survey/

## Academic & Research
- **MSc Advanced Computer Science (AI):** University of Leeds, 2025 to 2026. International Excellence Award and International Regional Award scholarships.
- **Research Assistant (LLM Systems):** University of Leeds, multi-agent pipeline converting NHS/NICE clinical guidelines into machine-readable ontologies.
- **Publication:** Co-author on attention span and mental health, 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON) 2024.
- **B.Tech:** Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, University of Pune, 2022 to 2025.
